description: Tie: a polyphonic legato — while a gate is held, a change of pitch glides to the new note instead of jumping

params.text: Sets how long a glide takes, up to 0.3 seconds
Bends the glide from logarithmic through linear to exponential
Sets how many samples the gate output is delayed by, 0 to 8

inputs.text: Sets the glide time when it is patched, with the glide time knob attenuating it; 10V into a fully open knob gives the longest glide
Holds the legato open: a pitch change while this is high glides, and a fresh gate jumps straight to the new pitch

outputs.text: The pitch, gliding between notes held under one gate
10V while a glide is running on that channel, 0V otherwise
The gate input, delayed by the number of samples the delay knob is set to, so a receiving module gets the new pitch before the gate

notes: nothing comes out of any output unless both the pitch input and the pitch output have cables; with the gate input unpatched the pitch passes through without gliding

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the glide time knob.
inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
